title: 항공정보간행물발간규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (123) Omitted.

(124) The Regulations on Publication of Aeronautical Information Publications are partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (1), the part of Article 2 (2) other than the subparagraphs, the part of Article 3 (1) other than the subparagraphs, Article 3 (2), and Article 5, the term "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport", respectively.

In Article 4, the term "revenues of the Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall be replaced with "revenues of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport".

(125) and (126) Omitted.
